Package frc.robot

Class RobotContainer

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.RobotContainer
public class RobotContainer extends Object
This class is responsible for binding the controls on the driver and operator controllers to actions and commands. It also manages the robot's subsystems and autonomous command selection. Robot subsystems are created here with appropriate implementations selected based on the current robot mode (real, simulation, or replay) via the AdvantageUtil.match() utility.

  • Constructor Details

    • RobotContainer

      public RobotContainer()
      Constructs the RobotContainer, initializing all subsystems and binding commands to controls.

      This constructor:

      • Creates the driver and operator Xbox controllers
      • Configures button bindings for driver inputs
      • Sets up the alerting system with controllers
      • Initializes the camera server

  • Method Details

    • configureBindings

      private void configureBindings()
      Configures all button bindings and command associations for driver and operator controls.

      This method sets up:

      • Default drive command for joystick control
      • Button bindings for various robot functions
      • Operator controls for mechanism manipulation

    • getAutonomousCommand

      public edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Command getAutonomousCommand()
      Returns the command to run during the autonomous phase. This method is called by the Robot class at the start of autonomous mode. The selected autonomous routine is determined by the AutoManager.
      Returns:
      The autonomous command to execute, or null if no autonomous routine is selected
